construction.quota: 2 per story, plus one for keysFarSide, iceLockClock, frozenGuards, deepClock
construction.selection: first successful layouts in fixed story-rotated order, prefer different silhouettes; no bot outcomes
construction.isolation: identical geometry, clock tile, obstacles, planned dig and holders; spare changes only clock.n; record every descriptor delta and failed request

decision.direction: non-decreasing family for three/luck/traps, non-increasing for spare; ties count but are reported separately
decision.exclusions: failed/unproven/changed-puzzle variants get no bot call; report missing coverage and actual descriptor movement separately

range.repeats: middle cell way14/three5/luck1, seeds2,3 on story indices 0,2,3,4,5,9
range.heldout: entire cell, including repeats, hash(story,way,three,luck,traps) mod5 ==0; frozen before ratings
range.trapAddendum: one most promising built cell per story, ranked by distance to both requested bands, then id; freeze exact briefs before new bot calls
